name: breadcrumbs-auto
title: Breadcrumbs from path
description: A breadcrumb built from the current URL path.
a11y: Same as Breadcrumb: a navigation landmark with an ordered list; the last crumb is the current page and not a link.

props.name: pathname
props.description: The current URL path, from your router: `/settings/billing`. Query and hash are ignored.

props.name: labels
props.description: Text for a path segment, keyed by the segment: `{billing: 'Billing and plans'}`. Others are the segment with dashes as spaces, capitalised.

props.name: homeLabel
props.description: Text of the first crumb, which links to `/`. Default "Home".
